title: Where I've put it to work.
intro: Five years of running social media for software, textile and healthcare brands, from first post to paid campaigns.

items.summary: Running the company's complete social media presence: daily content on the LinkedIn company page and brand pages, with paid campaigns on Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn.
items.challenge: A software and IT services company that needed a consistent, professional presence bringing engagement and real leads, not just posts.
items.outcome: A complete social media system: strategy, daily content, ad campaigns and reporting that turns content into engagement and engagement into leads.

items.summary: Managed the textile brand's Facebook and Instagram end to end for two years.
items.challenge: Low brand visibility on social media, and online sales that needed support from social campaigns.
items.outcome: Full page management, ad campaigns that lifted visibility and conversions, and an active, loyal follower community.

items.summary: Built the centre's online presence from the ground up.
items.challenge: No online presence and no way to reach parents and families online.
items.outcome: A social media presence built from zero, with regular posting, ad campaigns and video content that built audience engagement.
